item.description: Ancient animal bones from Ferriters Cove are now identified as bear and wild boar. This reclassification challenges decades of evidence for early farming in Ireland. Previously thought to be cattle, these remains are now understood differently. Modern scientific techniques revealed the true identity of these ancient specimens. This discovery prompts a reconsideration of Ireland's prehistoric transition to agriculture. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Wallabies came to New Zealand in 1912; they now threaten to spread across a third of the country
item.description: Wallabies introduced to New Zealand more than a century ago have now spread across more than 200,000 hectares in the Bay of Plenty region. The animals feed on native tree seedlings, ferns and grasses, damage plantation trees and compete with livestock for pasture. Authorities warn that unchecked wallabies could eventually occupy one-third of New Zealand by 2065 and cause $84 million in annual damage. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Researchers at Southern Illinois University Carbondale are developing protein-rich cookies made using plastic waste and agricultural waste.
